Price & timing

What shapes the final quotation

Fabric origin and composition, construction, custom details, fitting requirements and turnaround all affect the final price. We confirm the scope before work begins.

Typical planning window: shirts approximately 1–2 weeks; complex suits approximately 2–3 weeks. Actual timing depends on fabric availability, design, fittings, workload and location.
